binary_verification_scope: SHA256 pinned to build_manifest and all 64 run identities; WSL binary not reopened
limitations: Independent verification of exported traces and provenance, not an independent simulation.
suppressed_reply_events is verified as a bounded count in hashed metrics, not recounted from packets.csv because that column is not exported.
Only period3600 has 30 replications; period900/300 are single-run explorations without confidence intervals.
Intervals quantify variation across simulation runs and initial phases; packets/hours are not treated as independent replicates.
